claim.claim-text: a control unit that, when using a high frequency band having a frequency higher than a certain frequency band including one or a plurality of frequency ranges, increases a monitoring interval of a physical downlink control channel than when using the certain frequency band; and a receiving unit that receives the physical downlink control channel based on the monitoring interval that is larger than when using the certain frequency band.

2. The user terminal according to claim 1, comprising a transmission unit that transmits a terminal capability for monitoring of the physical downlink control channel having a minimum gap of the monitoring interval.
3. A radio communication method comprising the steps of:

when using a high frequency band having a frequency higher than a certain frequency band including one or a plurality of frequency ranges, increasing a monitoring interval of a physical downlink control channel than when using the certain frequency band; and receiving the physical downlink control channel based on the monitoring interval that is larger than when using the certain frequency band.
